scripts.dev:netlify-student: APP_ORIGIN=http://localhost:9999 netlify dev --filter web-student --command "npm run dev --workspace web-student -- --port 9998" --target-port 9998 --port 9999
scripts.dev:sandbox: PORT=3000 MOCK_AIRTABLE=true DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED=true APP_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5199 npm run dev:server & npm run dev --workspace web -- --port 5199
scripts.dev:student-sandbox: PORT=3001 MOCK_AIRTABLE=true DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED=true APP_ORIGIN=http://localhost:9999 npm run dev:student-server & npm run dev --workspace web-student
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace web-student && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web && npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace web-student && tsc --noEmit -p netlify/tsconfig.json
